a.lede: Tesla introduced a new feature to enable drivers to escape quickly while charging their vehicles in response to a mass shooting at a Supercharger location in Idaho in August that left seven people wounded and four dead. When a Tesla vehicle is charging, the plug is locked to the charging port and driving is disabled. […]
a.title: Tesla will now let you drive off mid-charge if there’s an emergency

b.lede: Tesla's new feature will let you drive away with the Supercharger still connected in case of emergencies.
b.title: Tesla rolls out an emergency drive-away feature after Supercharger shooting
